what: Today's lead commit helper refused formatted changes because its temporary staged copy had no pnpm package.
cause: pnpm 12.16.1 exec returned ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_NO_PACKAGE from the temporary folder. The helper reported every nonzero exit as bad formatting.
fix: Run the checkout's installed formatter directly against the staged copy. Keep the pinned config and relative paths, and report failed tool starts without printing its output.
test: Two regression scenarios failed on the original helper. Real pnpm reproduces the temporary-folder error. Real oxfmt checks staged bytes, the pinned config and excluded field rows. Missing, non-executable and failed formatter processes commit nothing.
